data.description:
Sie begleiten Hotels bei der technischen und energetischen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Gebäude und Anlagen. Dabei verbinden Sie technische Planung mit Projektleitung und begleiten unsere Kunden von der ersten Bestandsaufnahme über die Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die technische Gebäudeausrüstung und moderne Energietechnik – zum Beispiel Heizungsanlagen, Wärmepumpen, PV, Speicher und intelligente Energiesteuerung. Sie müssen dabei nicht aus der klassischen Energieberatung kommen: Entscheidend sind technisches Verständnis, Interesse an Gebäudetechnik und die Fähigkeit, Projekte strukturiert voranzubringen.

Aufgaben

• Sie übernehmen technische Projekte für unsere Hotelkunden – von der Bestandsaufnahme über die Planung bis zur Begleitung der Umsetzung.

• Sie führen Vor-Ort-Begehungen durch, analysieren vorhandene Heizungs- und Gebäudetechnik und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende technische Lösungen.

• Sie planen und bewerten beispielsweise Heizungsanlagen, Wärmepumpen, PV-Anlagen, Batteriespeicher und weitere Komponenten der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung.

• Sie begleiten die Umsetzung, stimmen sich mit Fachunternehmen und Kunden ab, prüfen technische Angebote und behalten Termine, Qualität und Kosten im Blick.

• Sie arbeiten an unseren Lösungen zur intelligenten Energiesteuerung von Hotels mit und bringen Ihr technisches Verständnis in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

• Sie erklären unseren Kunden technische Zusammenhänge und Empfehlungen verständlich und begleiten sie als zentraler Ansprechpartner durch das Projekt.

Qualifikation

Erforderlich:

• Studium, Techniker- oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Versorgungstechnik, TGA, Gebäudetechnik, Energietechnik, Bauingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich

• Gutes technisches Verständnis für Gebäude und deren Anlagentechnik

• Interesse daran, technische Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen und weiterzuentwickeln

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit – Sie können technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären und treten gegenüber Kunden und Fachunternehmen sicher auf

• Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Bereitschaft zu Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Hotelkunden deutschlandweit

Von Vorteil – aber keine Voraussetzung:

• Erfahrung in der technischen Projekt- oder Bauleitung

• Kenntnisse in Heizungs-, Klima-, Lüftungs- oder Regelungstechnik

• Erfahrung mit Wärmepumpen, PV, Batteriespeichern oder Gebäudeautomation

• Erfahrung in der Energieberatung oder energetischen Gebäudeplanung

• Kenntnisse im Fördermittelbereich (BEG, KfW, BAFA)

Benefits

aus.

data.description:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid is scaling fast — and our procurement function needs to keep pace, not just strategically, but operationally. As a Working Student in Direct Procurement, you're at the center of daily execution: securing component availability, managing supplier interactions, running RFQs, and making sure our contract manufacturers always have what they need to build.

You'll work in a supportive setup, but with genuine exposure to how a lean procurement team operates in a fabless environment. You'll report into our Procurement team and collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Sourcing, with involvement in new product introductions and supply chain activities. The scope spans electromechanical components, battery-related materials, and full product assemblies — across engineering samples, NPI, and series production.

Your Impact

  • Own daily operational purchasing: order management, delivery tracking, and availability monitoring for direct materials across our supply network

  • Run RFQs end-to-end — from initial inquiry and cost comparison through sample orders to series supply handover

  • Support early engineering phases with price indications and supplier benchmarks, anchoring cost targets before designs are locked

  • Act as the operational point of contact for our contract manufacturers — tracking commitments, escalating deviations, and keeping supply on track

  • Maintain and continuously improve purchasing data quality in NetSuite: lead times, MOQs, pricing, and supplier records

  • Contribute to cost-down initiatives through BoM-level price benchmarking and cross-supplier comparisons

  • Play an active role in building leaner, more digital purchasing processes through AI applications and automation


  • Currently enrolled in a degree program in economics, business administration, engineering, or a comparable field

  • First practical experience in procurement, supply chain, or operations — internships count

  • Comfortable with electromechanical components, assemblies, or hardware products: you understand what you're buying

  • Structured and reliable: you track your own tasks, follow up without reminders, and flag issues before they escalate

  • Clear and direct in supplier communication — confident in writing and conversation, in both German and English

  • Fluent in German and English; both are required for daily business

  • Nice to have: experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system; background in electronics, battery systems, or EMS and contract manufacturing environments

Your Benefits

  • Real responsibility from day one — not busywork, but meaningful ownership of live procurement tasks

  • Full-cycle exposure: from engineering support and RFQ through negotiation to series supply

  • A lean, senior team that gives direct feedback and expects you to push back when something doesn't add up

  • An inside view of what it takes to scale a hardware company — across supply chain, operations, and beyond

  • Flexible working hours coordinated around your university schedule

  • Generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnic origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.

data.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du reportest nicht, was passiert ist. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir wissen, was als Nächstes passieren muss.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas.

Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.000 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger:

Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau.

Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d), die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen.

Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen.

Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat.

Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst als Finance Business Partner die finanzielle Steuerung eines oder mehrerer zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Führungskräften zusammen.
  • Du steuerst relevante KPIs, Budgets und Ergebnisgrößen und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen nicht nur erkannt, sondern aktiv adressiert werden.
  • Du analysierst unsere P&L und Deckungsbeiträge bis auf Produkt-, Kanal-, Markt- oder Kostenstellenebene und identifizierst konkrete Ergebnishebel.
  • Du erstellst Forecasts, Szenarioanalysen und Business Cases und zeigst transparent, welchen finanziellen Effekt unterschiedliche Entscheidungen haben.
  • Du begleitest unsere Budget- und Jahresplanung und entwickelst sie zu einem dynamischen Steuerungsinstrument weiter.
  • Du analysierst Kostenentwicklungen und hinterfragst bestehende Strukturen konsequent auf Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Profitabilität.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Finance und Data aussagekräftige Management-Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Führungskräfte jederzeit die Zahlen kennen, die sie für ihre Entscheidungen tatsächlich benötigen.
  • Du verbindest operative KPIs mit finanziellen Auswirkungen und schaffst so Transparenz darüber, wo wir Geld verdienen, verlieren oder investieren sollten.
  • Du entwickelst klare Zielbilder, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs für deine Verantwortungsbereiche und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt bei Liquiditätsplanung, Cashflow-Steuerung und Working Capital Management.
  • Du analysierst Bestände, Einkauf, Zahlungsziele und Kapitalbindung und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung unseres Cash Conversion Cycles.
  • Du baust unsere Controlling-Prozesse weiter auf und treibst Automatisierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung konsequent voran.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Finance, Accounting, Data sowie den operativen Fachbereichen zusammen.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling, FP&A oder Finance Business Partnering mit.
  • Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Du verstehst eine P&L nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt.
  • Begriffe wie Contribution Margin, Cashflow, Working Capital, Forecast und Business Case gehören zu deinem täglichen Werkzeug.
  • Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren.
  • Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung.
  • Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen, statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Finanzler unmittelbar verstehen, was zu tun ist.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen.
  • Direkter Management-Zugang: Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Finance Leadership und den Verantwortlichen unserer Business Units zusammen.

  • Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht.

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.


Your mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.


Responsibilities

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.


Qualifications

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.


Nice to have

 Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

Your mission

As the Software IVV Lead, you will act as the independent software testing and verification authority, ensuring that the standards defined by our architecture are measurably adhered to, rigorously tested, and successfully audited. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of software validation and verification, serving as the ultimate quality gatekeeper for our software release candidates before they reach hardware integration and testing in the field.


Responsibilities

  • Define the Test Strategy: Establish and enforce the overarching software testing frameworks and QA processes (based on ISTQB) across all software capability teams.

  • Manage Test Infrastructure & Tooling: Oversee the setup and maintenance of software test environments and test data, ensure the qualification of testing tools, and lead the generation of audit-proof, revision-safe test evidence.

  • Oversee V&V Execution: Supervise the validation and verification phases of the V-Model, ensuring rigorous unit, integration, and sub-system-level testing are completed before handing over to the Hardware integration and Flight Testing teams.

  • Ensure Requirements Traceability: Deliver transparency in bidirectional traceability between Software Requirements, architectural design, implementation, and testing. Define and monitor the traceability processes in close collaboration with Software Configuration Management (SCM), ensuring operational compliance.

  • Govern Defect & Deviation Management: Establish and oversee the interfaces and processes for defect, deviation, and problem management, ensuring all findings from testing are systematically tracked, evaluated, and resolved.

  • Enforce Code Quality: Drive the adoption of strict coding standards (like MISRA for C++) using automated static analysis and code coverage metrics.

  • Interface with Configuration Management: Verify compliance with defined SCM processes, auditing baselines, versions, reproducible builds, Software Configuration Indexes, and Release Packages to ensure they meet quality standards.

  • Act as the Quality Gatekeeper: Provide independent quality gate approvals and formal release recommendations for software release candidates via the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process, while recognizing that the ultimate release decision resides with Product/Program Management.

  • Manage Audits: Lead the preparation, execution, and follow-up for all internal software QA assessments and external regulatory audits.


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in defining and enforcing software testing frameworks and QA processes based on ISTQB standards.

  • Deep expertise in managing the validation and verification (V&V) phases of the V-Model for complex software systems.

  • Hands-on experience with automated static analysis tools and enforcing coding standards such as MISRA for C++.

  • Strong background in requirements traceability and managing the interface between Software Requirements and test execution.

  • Solid knowledge of Software Configuration Management (SCM) processes, including version control, reproducible builds, and release auditing.

  • Demonstrated capability in defect and deviation management, ensuring systematic tracking and resolution of software findings.


Nice to have

  • Professional experience within the defense or aerospace sectors, working with safety-critical software systems.

  • Familiarity with preparing for and leading external regulatory audits and internal quality assessments.

  • Experience with flight testing operations or hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) integration environments.

About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, seeking visionary technical leaders who can define long-term technology roadmaps while remaining deeply hands-on with complex engineering problems. On the Electronic Warfare team, you will hold the highest level of technical authority for our attack and countermeasure capabilities, driving multi-domain architectures directly onto the modern battlefield.


Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Waveform Architect, you will own the entire development, architecture, and implementation of the waveform for our tactical anti-jam radio. In this critical role, you will ensure our communication links remain highly robust and operational under severe electronic countermeasure conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of the physical layer (PHY)—waveform, modulation, coding, framing, and synchronisation—from initial architecture to real-time execution.
  • Engineer solutions specifically tailored for challenging jamming scenarios and complex, multi-node long-range link budgets.
  • Own the PHY-side specifications and expose the critical IQ, phase, and timing observables required by the Direction Finding (DF) strand.
  • Define the development guidelines for the strand—including HDL and verification conventions, as well as FPGA build flows.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed a PHY and brought it onto FPGA/SoC hardware in real time.
  • You are quantitatively sure-footed on synchronisation, estimation, FEC (Forward Error Correction), and link budgets.
  • You have practical experience debugging real radio links against physical hardware.


Nice to have

  • Experience with anti-jamming and LPI/LPD (Low Probability of Intercept/Detection) in a tactical context.
  • A professional background at industry leaders.
  • Publicly verifiable PHY implementation evidence (e.g., custom GNU Radio OOT modules or contributions to the RFSoC toolchain).

About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, looking for proactive engineers who are excited to take mathematical models off the whiteboard and deploy them onto physical hardware. On our Electronic Warfare algorithms team, you will bridge the gap between theoretical signal processing and real-world hardware execution, taking direct ownership of key software and firmware modules.


Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer you will solve the critical challenges of directional wireless communication in highly dynamic networks. You will design and implement the medium access control (MAC) and routing layers that allow our platforms to form robust, self-healing networks under demanding tactical conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement MAC protocols and routing algorithms tailored for directional multi-node systems, directly tackling the challenge of neighbour discovery under highly focused, narrow beams.
  • Build dynamic TDMA schedules and beam coordination mechanisms in lockstep with the physical layer (PHY) and antenna steering systems, ensuring routing decisions are grounded in real-time RF characteristics rather than simple hop counts.
  • Deliver resilient multi-hop relay capabilities that sustain high-bandwidth video and control links between mobile platforms over tactical distances, routing back seamlessly to ground control stations under dynamic conditions.
  • Build and maintain multi-node Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds alongside automated logging pipelines to quantitatively evaluate and verify network join times and topology reform behaviours.
  • Mesh networking in a product that shipped — sim work alone does not qualify — plus Linux networking at kernel and packet level with live debugging.
  • Radio-literate and has designed a medium-access scheme or TDMA schedule.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed and shipped mesh networking protocols in commercial or defence products.
  • Deep, practical familiarity with the Linux networking stack at the kernel and packet levels, coupled with strong live-debugging skills on embedded systems.
  • Strong understanding of wireless propagation and physical layer realities, with hands-on experience designing medium-access control schemes or TDMA schedulers.


Nice to have

  • Active contributions to open-source routing protocols (e.g., batman-adv, olsrd, Babel).
  • A professional background at tactical mesh vendors (such as Silvus, Persistent Systems, TrellisWare, Saab, or Bittium).
  • Experience with mmWave backhaul systems or other technologies where directional beamforming is the default mode of operation.
  • Batman-adv / olsrd / Babel contributor; tactical mesh vendor background (Silvus, Persistent, TrellisWare, Saab, Bittium); mmWave backhaul — already thinks in beams.

About the team

You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director.


Your mission

As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator, you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis.
Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader. You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment.




Responsibilities

Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership

  • Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives.
  • Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities.
  • Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day.
  • Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency.
Flight Execution & Safety
  • Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards.
  • Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity.
  • Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics.
  • Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards.
Test Design & Data Analysis
  • Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA).
  • Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements.
  • Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance.
  • Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked.


Qualifications

Educational & Legal Background

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering.
  • NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
  • Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English.
Technical & Leadership Toolkit
  • Coordination Skills: Proven ability to lead a technical team on-site (three pilots and one engineer), manage schedules, and communicate priorities clearly under pressure.
  • Data Mastery: Practical experience in data reduction and analysis using MATLAB or Python.
  • UAV Systems: Familiarity with Ground Control Stations (GCS), telemetry systems, and mission planning tools.
  • Testing Rigor: Proven ability to plan and conduct system-level tests in an aerospace or defense environment.
Mindset & Style
  • The "General" Mindset: You are naturally organized and can work through ambiguity on the flight line.
  • Analytical & Decisive: You can analyze a data anomaly quickly and decide whether to continue testing.
  • Meticulous Documenter: You believe that if it wasn't documented with high fidelity, the test never happened.
Preferred Experience
  • Active experience with uncrewed aviation.
  • Hands-on experience with flight test instrumentation (FTI) and DAQ systems.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation environments.

data.description:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on October 1, 2026 our Department Knowledge Technologies for the Social Sciences (KTS), Team FAIR Data located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Research Data Manager (PostDoc) for mapping harvesting relationships
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, limited for three years)
 
The department Knowledge Technologies for Social Sciences (KTS) conducts research at the intersection of information retrieval, natural language processing, semantic technologies and human information interaction as foundation for innovative web portals and platforms for the search and use of research data. 

The HaFER project’s goal is to improve the visibility of German research data by identifying how metadata is propagated between the many services collecting such data. For this, we will build a map that will identify which data services harvest which metadata, and how metadata are transformed in the process. Based on this map we will offer best practices to the data services, negotiate with harvesters on how to present metadata better. The positions requires both networking capabilities within the relevant communities as well as technical skills to wrangle, model and analyze the metadata. 

 


Your tasks will be:

  • Managing and coordinating the HaFER project to make it a success 
  • Setting-up automated systems for metadata collection with the help of AI tools
  • Networking within the NFDI and other research data organizations to help promote the goals of HaFER, including organization of networking events
  • Conducting research in the topics of the department


Your profile:

  • Completed academic university degree (Master’s or equivalent) and completed PhD in Computer Science, Social Science or related subjects
  • Experience in Research Data Management, for example in the context of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI), or with services that harvest research metadata
  • Experience in handling, curating, harvesting and/or extracting research metadata on a technical level
  • Proven research record in the topics of the department, preferably Knowledge Graphs and/or Information Extraction
  • Excellent English skills are a must, German language skills are a plus


Our Benefits:

About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

At Trusted Shops, we’re shaping Europe’s Community of Trust – a space where Businesses and Consumers connect with confidence, transparency, and security. Every day, millions of Users and thousands of Companies across Europe trust us to deliver safe, reliable, and seamless digital experiences.

Data Services is shifting from being strong in raw data to reliably delivering prepared, standardized data products as the foundation for self-service reporting, product-facing APIs (Metrics-as-a-Service), and AI/agent access (e.g. via MCP). We are building these products inside one shared Data Lakehouse, where multiple domain teams build to a common standard. 

To make that real, we need someone to set the technical bar. As Principal Analytics Engineer (f/m/d) you define the lakehouse architecture and the standards that let teams move fast without fragmenting, you embed in the Product Data Domain to ship genuine data products, and you raise the craft of everyone around you. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with real autonomy. You shape how we build, not just execute a backlog.


To join our Data Service Domain, we are looking for a:

Principal Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)

Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)


Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture, with the teams. Define and evolve the lakehouse architecture (S3 + Apache Iceberg + Athena + dbt): table and layer design, partitioning and compaction, schema evolution, multi-team isolation, and unified catalog & discoverability. You design together with the teams, not in isolation

  • Standards that make data products real. Modeling conventions, the semantic layer, data-product definitions, testing and data-quality, CI/CD, documentation and metadata, so products are reliably consumable by humans, APIs, and AI agents alike

  • Exemplary delivery. Build data products in the Product domain that set the pattern others follow. You ship, not just advise

  • AI-ready data. Design metadata and semantic layers so agents query our metrics correctly; pioneer concrete AI use cases in the build workflow (AI-assisted modeling, testing, documentation, review)

  • Spotting what's next. Track the lakehouse, analytics-engineering, and AI landscape; run lightweight evaluations; and drive adoption of approaches that earn their place

  • Growing people. Mentor analysts and engineers, raise review quality, create technical clarity, and constructively question the status quo


Why Join Trusted Shops?

  • Personal Development: You’ll receive direct support from your Engineering Manager, ensuring your growth and success

  • Health & Wellbeing: Participate in monthly health activities and earn an extra vacation day for achieving health goals

  • Continuous Learning: Enjoy your “Self Education Day” every last Friday of the month, where you can focus on personal growth, attend internal tech talks, read a book, or work on your goals

  • Inclusive Work Culture: Flexible working options and a focus on work-life balance. No late-night work expected

  • If you want to know more about our organisation, feel free to check out the LinkedIn articles of our CTO


  • Deep, hands-on lakehouse experience. You have designed and built lakehouse architectures not just used one. You are strong with open table formats (Apache Iceberg or equivalent), object storage (S3), serverless query engines (Athena or equivalent), and dbt

  • Excellent analytics-engineering craft. Data-product and dimensional modeling, testing, CI/CD, and a real instinct for query performance and cost

  • Demonstrated technical leadership beyond a single team. You have set standards or architecture that other teams adopted, and you can influence without formal authority

  • A product mindset. You treat data as a product with consumers and SLAs, including non-human consumers (APIs, AI agents)

  • Concrete, hands-on AI experience in your own work, plus genuine curiosity and a bias toward responsible experimentation

  • Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity. You set direction, make calls, and bring people with you

What we offer you:

  • Hybrid work: Combine flexible remote work with team time in the Cologne office (on-site days depending on your location)

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • Permanent contract with Europe's trusted brand

  • One "Self Education Day" per month

  • 28 vacation days + 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Buddy programme (an experienced trustee is at your side)

  • Individual training opportunities

  • Events (Team Events, Unit Events, etc.)

  • Health Pass (free online and offline sports, fitness and health courses)

independent of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity. Trusted Shops is clearly committed to diversity and against discrimination.

About Trusted Shops

Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably.

With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. But trust is not only at the heart of our products, it also shapes how we work together. We believe in collaboration, ownership, and the freedom to do your best work through a flexible hybrid work culture. Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction.

To strengthen our Product Department, we are looking for a

Senior Product Performance Analyst (m/f/d)

(Hybrid in Cologne or Berlin / Full-time / Permanent contract)

As a Senior Product Performance Analyst, you'll turn scattered data into clear direction: unified KPIs, consistent dashboards, and actionable insights that influence product strategy and prioritization. Working closely with Product Managers and Product leadership, you'll help create a scalable data foundation that enables measurable decision-making across our Product organization. Your work will ensure that product investments, outcomes, and customer impact are guided by reliable data and transparent performance measurements.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on measurement, tracking concepts, and performance evaluation within the Product organization.

  • Support the product teams in the early stages of product development in formulating the right hypotheses and success metrics to shape the development phase and create the needed data points.


Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Several years of experience in data analytics or product analytics, ideally within a product organization.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with data lakes or data warehouses.

  • Proficiency with BI, reporting, and data visualization tools.

  • Proven experience building KPI frameworks, reporting standards, and scalable measurement structures.

  • Independent, project-oriented working style with the ability to communicate complex data insights to diverse stakeholders.

  • Business fluent English; additional language skills are a plus.

Purpose?

You will be part of our in-house Creative Team and help create visual content for our e-commerce brands and products. From packaging and product images to Amazon listings and social media content, your designs will be seen by thousands of customers across Europe.


Expected results for this role in the first 12 months?

Typical job ads are boring. We'd rather tell you directly what you will actually be working on.

As a Working Student Graphic Designer, you will support our Creative Team across several brands and products. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Create and adapt packaging designs, user manuals, and product illustrations
  • Retouch and edit product photos in Adobe Photoshop
  • Design marketing graphics and product images for Amazon and other e-commerce platforms
  • Adapt existing designs and content for different products, languages, and markets
  • Support the creation of visuals for social media and other marketing materials
  • Use modern AI tools to support image creation, editing, and creative workflows
  • Contribute ideas and help maintain consistent branding across our products and brands


Required skills and experience?

You don't need years of professional experience. This is a working student position, and we expect you to still be learning. What matters to us is that you already have a good design foundation and want to develop your skills in a professional environment.

  • You're currently studying graphic, media, communication design, or a comparable field
  • You already have first practical experience in graphic design through university projects, internships, freelance work, or previous jobs
  • You're confident using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
  • You have experience with Figma or similar design tools
  • You have a good eye for layout, typography, composition, and details
  • You're interested in e-commerce, product design, and modern consumer brands
  • You're curious about AI tools and interested in using them as part of your creative workflow
  • You work independently, reliably, and take ownership of your tasks
  • You have very good German and English skills
Please include a portfolio or examples of your design work with your application.


This is who we are. Do you find yourself here?

You can find our Core Values in the About Us section of our website. That's how we work. If you like taking ownership, finding solutions, questioning things instead of simply accepting them, and working together to get things done, you'll probably fit in well with our team.


What's in it for you?

  • VARIETY: Work on real products and brands across packaging, e-commerce, photography, and digital content.
  • LEARNING: Work directly with our in-house designers and photographers and develop your skills through real projects and regular feedback.

  • MOBILITY: Monthly support for your public transport ticket.
  • TEAM: A young, ambitious, and international team with short decision-making processes and plenty of room to contribute your own ideas.

Intro

Empfehlungsbonus!❤ Kennst du jemanden, der/die perfekt zu dieser Stelle passt? Dann empfiehl uns die Person. Startet deine Empfehlung erfolgreich dieses Werkstudium bei GreenMedical, erhältst du als Dankeschön einen 100-€ Wunschgutschein.*



Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.  
Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo. 

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten. 

Du willst im Venture Development durchstarten und konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen sammeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt für ein Werkstudium und werde ein zentraler Akteur in der Entwicklung eines neuen HealthTech Ventures. Bringe deinen unternehmerischen Geist ein und hilf uns, innovativen Zugang zu Gesundheit zu ermöglichen.


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- & Potenzialanalysen: Du führst Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen sowie Literatur- und Desk-Recherchen durch, identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Geschäftsmodellentwicklung: Du wirkst an der Entwicklung und Validierung neuer Geschäftsmodelle mit und begleitest deren Weiterentwicklung bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und entwickelst Kooperationen mit externen Stakeholdern strukturiert weiter.
  • Konzepte & Business Cases: Du bereitest Konzepte, Business Cases und Entscheidungsunterlagen adressatengerecht und überzeugend für interne und externe Stakeholder auf.
  • Projektsteuerung & Prozessentwicklung: Du analysierst Prozesse, strukturierst Anforderungen und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich, um digitale Versorgungsangebote kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit & Eigenmotivation: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Mindset, arbeitest proaktiv, übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst kreativ und bist bereit, für gute Ergebnisse die Extrameile zu gehen.
  • Analytisches & problemlösungsorientiertes Denken: Du kannst komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert durchdringen, Kennzahlen und Business Cases aufbereiten sowie daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Selbstständige & strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, sorgfältig und organisiert, behältst auch bei Unsicherheit, wechselnden Prioritäten oder mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
  • Kommunikation & Informationsverarbeitung: Du kannst neue Informationen schnell erfassen, kritisch einordnen und adressatengerecht aufbereiten. Zudem kommunizierst du klar, arbeitest gerne im Team und gehst offen sowie konstruktiv mit Feedback um.
  • PowerPoint & Excel: Du verfügst über einen sicheren Umgang mit PowerPoint und grundlegende Excel-Kenntnisse zur Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten.
  • Interesse am Gesundheitsbereich: Du begeisterst dich für den Gesundheitsmarkt, digitale Innovationen und HealthTech und möchtest die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Praktische Erfahrungen: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Business Development, Venture Development, HealthTech oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
  • Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
  • Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.


Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da.

Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. Wenn du Fragen hast oder etwas unklar ist, melde dich einfach bei unserem Recruiting-Team unter ----- – wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

*Teilnahmebedingungen:
Die Empfehlung muss durch die Bewerberin oder den Bewerber im Online-Bewerbungsformular von GreenMedical über das Feld „Hat dich jemand empfohlen?“ angegeben werden. Andere Meldewege werden nicht berücksichtigt. Bei der Nennung mehrerer Personen entfällt der Prämienanspruch.
Die Prämie wird nur gewährt, wenn die empfohlene Person eingestellt wird und das Praktikum tatsächlich antritt. Die empfehlende Person muss sich nach Praktikumsbeginn selbstständig bei GreenMedical melden.
Die Prämie besteht aus einem Wunschgutschein im Wert von 100 Euro. Eine Barauszahlung oder ein Umtausch sind ausgeschlossen. Etwaige steuerliche Pflichten trägt die empfangende Person.

Im Produktmanagement für unsere professionelle Hair-Care-Marke Urban Alchemy verantwortest Du die Entwicklung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktportfolios – von der Idee bis zur Kommerzialisierung. Du analysierst Markt-, Preis- und Wettbewerbsdaten, steuerst Produktentwicklungen und arbeitest eng mit Lieferanten, Herstellern, R&D und internationalen Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Gleichzeitig bringst Du Deine kreativen Ideen in die Produktkommunikation ein und verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen die Konzeption und Durchführung von Kommunikationskampagnen. Als (Senior) Global Product & Brand Manager berichtest Du direkt an den Vice President Own Brands und führst zwei Direct Reports.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Produktmanagement & Portfolio-Strategie: Eigenständige Steuerung des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus - von der Ideenfindung über Formulierungs- und Packaging-Briefings bis zur Markteinführung; Verantwortung für Sortimentsgestaltung, Produktinnovation und Portfolio-Bereinigung

  • Budget- & Kostenverantwortung: Eigenständige Steuerung von Projekt- und Produktbudgets inkl. Kosten- und Margenkalkulation sowie Analyse und Optimierung der Produktwirtschaftlichkeit
  • Launch-Steuerung: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Produkteinführungen inkl. Zeitplänen, Stücklisten und Forecasts sowie Abstimmung mit Vertrieb, Supply Chain und internationalen Märkten
  • Testing & Qualitätssicherung: Organisation und Begleitung interner und externer Produkttests zur Validierung von Claims, Wirksamkeit und Qualität sowie Steuerung notwendiger Optimierungen
  • Kommunikation & Kampagnen: Entwicklung kreativer Ideen und Konzepte für die Produktkommunikation sowie Verantwortung für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Kommunikationskampagnen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen

Das bringst Du mit

B. als (Senior) Product Manager, Product Development Manager, Global Product Manager, Product Innovation Manager, Product Portfolio Manager oder Category Manager, idealerweise im FMCG-, Beauty- oder Professional-Hair-Care-Bereich
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Produktentwicklung, im Lieferanten- und Produktionsmanagement sowie in der Steuerung von Produkten über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus

  • Leidenschaft und fundierte Erfahrung im Go-to-Market- und Launch-Management sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Produktkonzepte
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit und Verhandlung mit externen Lieferanten und Herstellern sowie im Management internationaler Partner

  • Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein hohes Maß an Problemlösungskompetenz und Organisationsstärke
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und Überzeugungskraft in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Mut zu neuen Ideen, Innovationsgeist und die Durchsetzungskraft, diese erfolgreich in konkrete Produkte, Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Projekte zu überführen
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Das bieten wir Dir

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Arbeite mit einem kreativen, hochmotivierten Team an Themen am Puls der Zeit - hier gestaltest Du aktiv mit!
  • Internationales Flair & Start-up Vibes: Agiles Arbeiten in einem globalen Umfeld mit echter "Du"-Kultur und flachen Hierarchien

  • Kein Tag wie der andere: Vielfältige, spannende Projekte in einem dynamischen, wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Innovationen zum Anfassen: Entdecke angesagte Trendprodukte zum Vorteilspreis - plus jede Menge Freebies
  • Dein Wohlfühl Boost: Profitiere von starken Fitness-Deals, Fahrradleasing, Corporate Benefits und Rabatt bei unseren Partnerfriseuren
  • Late Night im Office? Kein Problem - Dein Abendessen geht auf uns. Einfach bestellen und weitermachen, wenn’s mal länger dauert
  • Deutschlandticket? Sharing is caring: Wir bezuschussen Dein Ticket für maximale Mobilität
  • Work your way: Modern ausgestattetes Office im Herzen von München und Homeoffice inklusive

Your mission

You are the architect and builder of the customer-facing side of the LEASETEQ platform in Berlin, and the owner of our German market on it. You design the digital application journey and the portals that carry real customers, dealers and operations teams at production scale, and you make sure German credit rules, compliance requirements and dealer flows are represented correctly in a platform that also serves Switzerland and Austria. You work in a small, senior team where your decisions have direct product impact, and you naturally bring AI tooling into your daily engineering workflow without being asked.

What you will do

  • Own the German market on our customer-facing platform: credit and compliance requirements, dealer flows, German copy, and the acceptance criteria that make them verifiable
  • Design and build the digital application journey — multi-step forms, validation, resumable state, document upload, KYC steps and the unhappy paths users actually hit
  • Build and maintain the customer, dealer and operations portals, including the operations board and the logic that decides where a case belongs
  • Write the use-case and API layers behind the journey to our clean-architecture standard — this is a full-stack role, not a UI role
  • Own field-level mapping into the CRM and the Flowable-based process engine — beneficial ownership, source of funds, origin of income, additional persons — where a wrong key is a compliance defect, not a cosmetic one
  • Author specification-driven change proposals, and act as the named human approver for journey and mapping changes in the German market
  • Grow end-to-end test coverage on the critical journeys: coverage is what licenses autonomous agent work in a module
  • Work with our Berlin backend team on the seam between the orchestration core and the customer-facing platform, and with our Jakarta platform engineers who own the journey across all three markets
  • Communicate clearly in German and English with engineering peers and business stakeholders


Your profile

  • 6+ years of full-stack TypeScript engineering, with recent production work in React and Next.js App Router — server components, server actions and route handlers, with a clear grasp of what runs where — is mandatory
  • Fintech experience is mandatory: production work on a regulated financial product — leasing, lending, banking, payments or insurance — where money moved and a regulator could ask why
  • Proven ownership of a complex multi-step onboarding or application flow is mandatory: validation strategy, partial persistence and resumption, conditional branching by market or product, document upload
  • Real backend capability: use cases, repository implementations, API handlers and PostgreSQL / Prisma queries — roughly a 60/40 split toward the frontend, not 90/10
  • State and data-fetching maturity (Zustand or equivalent, TanStack Query) and confident use of form and schema tooling (Formik or React Hook Form with Zod), including server-side validation parity
  • End-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress on flows that are slow, stateful and integration-dependent
  • AI-first engineering mindset: daily use of coding assistants and agents on production work, and the ability to write a change specification precise enough that an agent implements it correctly and a reviewer can verify that it did
  • Working understanding of the German regulatory environment for consumer credit or asset finance — BaFin-supervised context, AML/KYC obligations, consumer-credit disclosure — is a strong plus
  • Internationalisation as a habit — no hard-coded strings, and awareness of what four locales do to layout and copy
  • Fluent German and English


Why us?

  • Founding-team-level ownership of our customer-facing platform and of the German market on it
  • Direct collaboration with the CTO and the founders, including regular visits to our Swiss headquarters
  • A genuinely AI-first process, not a slogan: specification-driven delivery where agents execute approved changes and humans own scope, architecture, regulatory and release decisions
  • Hybrid setup with 2-3 days per week in our coworking office in Berlin (WeWork, Stresemannstrasse)
  • Competitive and fair salary: €70,000 - €90,000 gross per year, depending on experience and impact
  • 10–15% annual bonus tied to company performance and clear OKRs
  • Tax-free monthly benefit allowance of €50 that you can use for what you personally value

  • Additional health insurance options, including enhanced coverage for dental and vision care
  • Company-supported pension scheme with employer contributions on top of the statutory system
  • Employer-funded disability coverage starting from day one of employment
  • Dedicated AI tooling budget (e.g. Cursor, Claude API) so you can experiment and move fast
  • Modern Apple devices
  • Our remote policy promises 4 weeks & worldwide
About LEASETEQ
LEASETEQ builds the orchestration brain for mid-market car leasing and asset finance in the DACH region. Our platform automates the full contract lifecycle – from origination and credit decision through to end-of-term – using Flowable BPM as the core process engine on a modern, event-driven micro-services architecture, with a Next.js / TypeScript platform serving our customer, dealer and operations portals in four languages across Switzerland, Germany and Austria.
We are an AI-first engineering team: agents, intelligent workflows and LLM-augmented automation are how we build today, not items on a future roadmap. From our base in Switzerland, our subsidiaries in Austria and Germany and our engineering team in Jakarta, you join a small, senior team where your decisions have visible impact on customers, partners and the future of our product.

Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!
