For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the operating system for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives.

The role

Lucis analyses more than 110 biomarkers, builds personalised clinical protocols, and delivers them through an AI-powered preventive health product.

As Medical Excellence, you are the senior medical expert next to product and Medical ops. You bring deep clinical expertise into protocols, ranges, evidence, and what we can say next to a marker. You also cover medical content: biomarker copy, protocols, and marketing clinical sign-off.

You work with the product lead, Medical ops, medical reviewers, and AI. You do not own product decisions, and you do not own labs, partners, or turnaround — Medical ops does.

This is not a traditional bedside role. It is not an ops role. It is not a copywriting role. You have practiced medicine in depth, and you can turn clinical judgment into clear protocols, ranges, and member-facing language.

What you own

Protocols & clinical standards

  • Protocol logic, decision trees, clinical rules

  • Biomarker thresholds and expert ranges

  • Translate medical reasoning into structures the product and Medical ops can run

  • Keep protocols aligned with current evidence

  • Support new biomarkers, health systems, and preventive programmes from the clinical side

Evidence & clinical judgment

  • Evidence bar: what we should test, drop, or claim

  • Brief product and the team without a 40-page memo

  • Clinical review of edge cases and sensitive outputs

  • Review of AI-generated medical outputs for clinical accuracy and safety

Medical content

  • Biomarker explanations, protocol rationales, in-product clinical language

  • Coach / member-facing clinical copy

  • Marketing clinical sign-off

  • French and English at publication quality

  • Keep member-facing clinical language trustworthy

Medical quality and governance

  • Clinical review and sign-off processes (clinical side: what must be medically signed off, and to what standard)

  • Quality-control systems, documentation standards, audit trails — in partnership with Medical ops

  • Escalation and medical risk-management processes — clinical criteria and judgment

  • Clinical performance indicators — definition of medical quality bars, with Medical ops on measurement and ops

About you

You are a doctor with substantial clinical practice. You care that what members read and what protocols encode is medically sound. You are comfortable working with product and AI without needing to run either. You write like a clinician people would trust.

You’ll fit in well if

  • You hold an MD (preferred) with deep clinical practice — more experience than a junior reviewer

  • Prevention, internal medicine, nutrition, functional, cardiology, public health, or a related field is a plus

  • You have strong clinical judgement, case by case and when defining standards

  • You can set protocol logic, ranges, and an evidence bar other people can execute

  • You write clearly in French and English at publication quality

  • You work well with product, Medical ops, AI, and reviewers — without owning their roadmaps

  • You balance medical rigour with pragmatism

  • You take ownership beyond a narrow specialty lane

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)

Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

data.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, building high-performing consumer products in mobile gaming. We're scaling a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players, and here, data isn't just analyzed, it's turned into systems that directly drive business performance.

As a Senior AI Data Expert (f/m/x), you'll operate at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics, building and scaling the data foundation that powers our entire business. This role combines all four data disciplines into one generalist position, you move to wherever the highest-value data problem is, rather than staying inside one lane. This isn't a role for maintaining pipelines or following predefined processes, we look for engineering mindset and entrepreneurial ownership: you build it, you own it, and you see the impact in production. AI is not a side tool here, it's core to how you work: you'll use Claude and similar AI tools daily to plan, build, debug, and document, including managing context and memory across projects, integrating AI directly into your version control workflow, and running parallel agent workflows on separate tasks, cutting repetitive tasks so you can focus where it actually moves the needle.

We believe a small team of engineers working closely with AI can outperform a much larger traditional data team, and we're building this role around that belief, not around AI as an occasional convenience.

If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, and data-driven decisions, and impact matters more to you than process, we want to hear from you. We use AI for everything in order to improve speed and quality.

What You’ll Own:

  • Data Pipelines & Integration: You design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines on Databricks to integrate data from various sources, including app and web products and marketing partner data, ensuring reliable and efficient data flow across the business.

  • Data Lakehouse Ownership: You build and manage the Data Lakehouse on Databricks, including migrating legacy data products, and implement data transformations and processing logic using Databricks and PySpark.

  • Monitoring & Optimization: You monitor and maintain the data stack for nightly and near-real-time processing of in-house tracking solutions, continuously optimizing and troubleshooting pipelines to ensure data quality and integrity.

  • Analysis & Insight: You also turn open business questions into decision-ready analysis when that's where the highest-value work is, not just build the pipelines that feed it.

  • AI-Native Workflow: You use Claude and similar AI tools daily, not occasionally, to plan, build, debug, and document your pipelines, treating AI as a core part of the job rather than an add-on.

  • Version Control & Worktrees: You integrate AI directly into your version control workflow, using Git worktrees (or an equivalent) to run several AI-assisted branches of work side by side, rather than treating AI and your codebase as separate.

  • Context & Memory Management: You maintain structured project context for your AI tools, for example a CLAUDE.md-style instructions file, so they stay accurate and useful as pipelines and codebases grow, rather than relying on ad hoc prompts each time.

  • Parallel Agentic Work: You run multiple AI coding agents on separate tickets at the same time where it makes sense, reviewing and integrating their output rather than writing every line serially yourself.

  • AI-Assisted Communication: You're comfortable using AI to help manage day-to-day coordination, including in Slack, when it's the faster and more reliable way to keep things moving.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You move fluidly across data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics work, depending on where the team needs you most, rather than staying fixed in one discipline.

  • Staying Ahead: You stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering and applied AI, bringing new ideas and approaches to the team.


What You Bring

  • Technical Foundation: You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or bootcamp experience, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience across data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics.

  • Cross-Disciplinary Range: You have real experience in at least two of data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics, and you're comfortable picking up the others as the role demands.

  • Current, Deep Databricks Experience: You are proficient in designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL processes on Databricks, with at least a year of current, hands-on depth, not brief or dated exposure.

  • Tools & Technologies: You have hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, and Lambda or similar technologies. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and familiarity with PostgreSQL are a plus.

  • Genuine AI Fluency: You use AI tools like Claude hands-on, daily, across planning, building, debugging, and documentation, not just for occasional testing. This is a core, non-negotiable part of the role, not a nice-to-have.

  • Context Engineering: You know how to set up and maintain project context and memory for AI coding tools, structured instructions and reusable prompts, so they stay effective as a codebase grows rather than relying on default settings.

  • Agentic & Worktree Fluency: You're comfortable running several tickets in parallel with AI assistance, using Git worktrees or a similar approach to keep parallel AI-assisted branches isolated and reviewable, and you can explain your actual workflow in detail rather than describing it as something that just happens automatically.

  • Programming Skills: You are highly proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark for data manipulation and processing, and you write clean, maintainable, production-ready code.

  • Mindset & Communication: You have excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing, comfortable letting AI take on a meaningful share of day-to-day coordination, and genuinely open to a way of working where AI reshapes how data teams operate, not just tolerant of it.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants.

Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team. Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics.

In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch.

  • Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers.

  • Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants.

  • Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs.

  • Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes.

  • Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world.


What Success Looks Like

  • Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases.

  • Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows.

  • Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods.

  • Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

  • Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods.


What We Are Looking For
  • Languages: English + Portuguese + Spanish are a must.

  • Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions based on insights rather than intuition.

  • Technical Fluency: Experience working with APIs, automation tools, and technical teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.

  • Customer-Obsessed Mindset: Ability to deeply understand user needs and translate them into frictionless product experiences.

  • Exceptional Collaboration Skills: Ability to work effectively with engineering, compliance, commercial teams, and external stakeholders.

  • Bias for Action: A pragmatic approach to decision-making, balancing long-term vision with near-term execution

In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.

In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

Qualifikation

✔ Du kannst IT-Infrastrukturen planen, aufbauen & managen.

✔ Windows-Server, Active Directory, Firewalls, VPNs, Backups & Co. – kennst du wie deine Westentasche.

✔ Denkst in Lösungen, nicht in Problemen.

✔ Bist kommunikativ & kein Nerd im Elfenbeinturm.

✔ Hast einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

✔ Bonus: Du hast schon mal mit IT in Zahnarztpraxen gearbeitet – kein Muss, aber nice to have.

Benefits

💰 Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt – dein Einsatz wird belohnt
🎯 Junges, agiles Team – kein verstaubter IT-Laden, sondern moderne, coole Kollegen.
🚀 Kein Micro-Management – du bekommst Verantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit.
🎧 Flexible Arbeitsweise – Homeoffice möglich, wenn’s passt.

What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration across departments to achieve common goals.
  • Partner with operations to ensure smooth product delivery and availability across all channels.
Performance Analysis:
  • Monitor and analyze the performance of the Shoes category, identifying opportunities for growth and areas for improvement.


What you will bring:

  • Proven experience (4-5 years) in a merchandising or product management role within the luxury fashion industry, ideally with a focus on footwear.
  • Strong understanding of the luxury market, including D2C and B2B dynamics.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across departments.
  • Passion for luxury fashion, design, and craftsmanship.


What we offer:

  • A bright and spacious design office in the heart of Berlin embodying our brand values and focusing on employee well-being.
  • A unique chance to shape our company’s future and build a global brand, all within a motivating, international work environment with employees of 14+ nationalities.
  • A high level of responsibility, creative freedom, and the opportunity to bring your originality, ideas, and independence to life.
  • Once-per-season gift voucher, to be used on Aeyde footwear and accessories.
  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, Berlin Public Transport pass or German lessons for international employees.
  • 30 days of holidays.
  • Flexible hybrid working model subject to team specifications.
  • Regular team events include our Christmas and Summer Party as well as extraordinary monthly team lunches.
  • Relocation assistance available including visa support.

data.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

data.description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

Breathment is a Munich-based digital health startup. We digitize pulmonary rehabilitation for people living with chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD: our app guides patients through therapy exercises at home, watches their movement through the phone camera and gives feedback in real time, while physiotherapists and physicians follow their progress remotely through our telemonitoring platform. We work with German clinics, physiotherapists and health insurers, and every release reaches real patients.

We are looking for a senior engineer who is at home in both worlds: computer vision and production backend. You will own the path from neural-network output to what the patient sees on screen and what the therapist reads in the report.

Tasks

  • Own the computer-vision pipeline that turns pose-estimation output from our neural networks into repetition counts, posture feedback and set-by-set exercise analysis.
  • Design the reporting layer that converts raw movement data into clinical reports physiotherapists act on.
  • Build and extend our Python backend (FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis): the API behind the patient app and the clinician platform.
  • Ship to production on Kubernetes with GPU inference services, and stand behind what you ship: tests, monitoring and clean handovers.
  • Analyse requirements together with product, physiotherapists and the mobile team, and propose solutions instead of waiting for tickets.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development in Python, including production REST APIs (FastAPI or comparable).
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). You have built real product features on top of model output, not only trained models in notebooks.
  • Solid experience with NoSQL databases, ideally MongoDB, and with data models that survive growth.
  • A fluent Git and GitHub workflow: branches, reviews, CI.
  • Strong analytical thinking and an independent, structured way of working. You can take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a shipped result in a remote team.
  • Professional working proficiency in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Genuine interest in startups: you want responsibility, and you want to see the effect of your work on patients.

Nice to have

  • Pose estimation, human motion analysis or video processing (OpenCV, MediaPipe or similar).
  • Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployments; workflow engines such as Temporal.
  • Software in a regulated environment: medical devices, health data, GDPR.

Benefits

  • Impact you can see: your code helps patients rehabilitate at home instead of waiting months for a clinic place.
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere.
  • A small senior team with short decision paths and direct access to founders, physiotherapists and users.
  • A modern stack: Python 3, FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis, PyTorch, Kubernetes, GPU inference.

Du arbeitest im Influencer Marketing und denkst manchmal: Da müsste eigentlich noch mehr gehen? Mehr Strategie. Mehr Verantwortung. Größere Marken. Größere Ideen. Ein eigenes Team. Und vor allem mehr Einfluss darauf, was am Ende wirklich passiert und was im besten Fall die Branche prägt?

Then keep reading. 👀

Ykone zählt zu den führenden Influencer Marketing Agenturen weltweit. Seit über 13 Jahren gestalten wir die Branche mit und arbeiten heute mit internationalen Top Brands aus Beauty, Fashion, Luxury, Lifestyle und Tech. Von München über Paris, Mailand und London bis Dubai verbinden unsere Teams lokale Expertise mit einem globalen Netzwerk.

In Deutschland sind wir gerade in einer besonders spannenden Phase: Wir wachsen, gewinnen große internationale Etats und entwickeln gleichzeitig weiter, wie Influencer Marketing in Zukunft funktioniert. Strategischer, kreativer, technologischer und skalierbarer.

Das macht Ykone zu einem Ort für Menschen, die mehr wollen als den nächsten Job. Die Verantwortung übernehmen, große Ideen vorantreiben, andere mitnehmen und wirklich Einfluss darauf haben wollen, was wir als Agentur und für unsere Kunden aufbauen.

Aufgaben

Wir suchen jemanden, der übernimmt. Als Account Lead Influencer Marketing & Brand Strategy verantwortest du mehrere unserer wichtigsten internationalen Kunden aus Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle und Tech.

Du entwickelst ihre Influencer Strategie, berätst Marketing Leads auf Senior Level, führst große Pitches, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Konzepte und erkennst Business Potenziale, bevor der Kunde danach fragt.

Und: Du führst Menschen. Nicht im Sinne von Aufgaben verteilen und Status Calls führen. Sondern indem du Standards setzt, andere besser machst, challengest, inspirierst, Entscheidungen triffst und deinem Team zutraust, über sich hinauszuwachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Accounts führen: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für mehrere unserer wichtigsten Kunden und bist strategische Ansprechpartner auf Senior Level. Du kennst ihr Business, ihre Herausforderungen und Ziele und denkst ihnen einen Schritt voraus.
  • Strategische Richtung vorgeben: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Strategy und deinem Team Jahresstrategien und große Kampagnenideen, challengest bestehende Ansätze und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit nicht nur kreativ überzeugt, sondern auf die Business- und Marketingziele unserer Kunden einzahlt.
  • Business entwickeln: Du erkennst Potenziale, bevor daraus ein Briefing entsteht. Du identifizierst neue Themen, Services und Budgets, entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiter aus.
  • Pitches gewinnen: Du führst große Pitches und strategische Präsentationen federführend, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Spezialist die richtige Story und überzeugst Kunden von unseren Ideen.
  • Teams führen und entwickeln: Du führst dein eigenes Account-Team, gibst Richtung und klare Standards vor und entwickelst Menschen weiter. Du musst nicht jede Aufgabe selbst lösen. Dein Job ist es, dein Team so gut zu machen, dass es Verantwortung übernehmen und über sich hinauswachsen kann.
  • Die richtigen Expert zusammenbringen: Influencer Marketing ist für uns längst mehr als klassische Kampagnen. Du verbindest deine Accounts mit unseren Expert aus Strategy, Creative, Events, Social, Paid und Scaled Campaigns und entwickelst daraus Lösungen, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen.
  • Wirtschaftliche Verantwortung übernehmen: Du steuerst Budgets und Ressourcen über deine Accounts hinweg, behältst Forecast, Profitabilität und Wachstum im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit unternehmerischem Verständnis.
  • Qualität verantworten: Du musst nicht in jedem Projekt operativ arbeiten, aber du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass Strategie, Kreation und Umsetzung unseren Anspruch erfüllen und Ergebnisse liefern.
  • YKONE mitgestalten: Du denkst über deine eigenen Accounts hinaus, bringst neue Ideen und Perspektiven ein, challengest uns als Agentur und hilfst dabei, unsere Services, Teams und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Das könnte dein Job sein, wenn du ...

👀 Influencer Marketing nicht nur ausführst, sondern wirklich verstehst. Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Vollzeit-Erfahrung auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite mit und kennst die Branche, Creator, Managements und ihre Mechaniken.

🧠 Marken strategisch beraten willst, statt Briefings einfach abzuarbeiten. Du entwickelst Jahresstrategien, übersetzt Business- und Marketingziele in klare Influencer-Strategien und kannst deine Empfehlungen auch auf Senior-Level überzeugend vertreten.

🚀 Verantwortung nicht erst übernimmst, wenn sie dir jemand offiziell übergibt. Du hast bereits große Kunden und idealerweise siebenstellige Budgets verantwortet und fühlst dich wohl damit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und für Ergebnisse einzustehen.

🤝 aus guten Kundenbeziehungen langfristige Partnerschaften und neues Business machen kannst. Du erkennst Potenziale, denkst über das bestehende Briefing hinaus und hast Lust darauf, deine Accounts aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und wachsen zu lassen.

👥 Menschen nicht nur managen, sondern besser machen willst. Du hast bereits Teams oder Kolleg geführt und weiterentwickelt, kannst klare Erwartungen setzen, konstruktiv challengen und Verantwortung abgeben.

💡 Ideen hast, die nicht nur kreativ sind, sondern unsere Kunden weiterbringen. Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen, eine strategische Richtung vorgeben und aus einer ersten Idee eine überzeugende Story machen.

📱 TikTok, Instagram und YouTube auf Marketer-Level verstehst. Formate, Plattformmechaniken, Creator-Ecosystem und relevante Benchmarks gehören für dich zum Handwerkszeug und du interessierst dich dafür, was als Nächstes kommt.

📈 große Ziele eher motivierend als einschüchternd findest. Du willst nicht nur gute Kampagnen umsetzen, sondern Kunden, Teams und Business entwickeln und hast Lust darauf, an deinem eigenen Impact gemessen zu werden.

Und vielleicht am wichtigsten:

Du liebst diese Branche wirklich. Du bist neugierig auf das, was sich verändert, hast eine Meinung dazu, was gutes Influencer Marketing heute und morgen ausmacht, und willst die nächsten Jahre nicht nur dabei sein, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit internationalen Top-Marken und Budgets, die wirklich etwas bewegen

Du solltest ihn machen, wenn du irgendwann auf die nächsten Jahre deiner Karriere zurückblicken und sagen willst: Ich habe nicht einfach tolle Accounts betreut. Ich habe etwas aufgebaut und mitgestaltet.

Klingt nach dir? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Kein Roman als Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV und am liebsten 2 bis 3 Cases, auf die du wirklich stolz bist. Und sag uns, was daran dein Anteil war.

  • Shape the German Playbook: Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.


Your Profile

  • An established network: You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities.

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We’re a high‑energy cloud- and data engineering team looking for like-minded, motivated tech builders. We are driven by ownership and business outcomes.  
As the analytics unit within a global management consultancy, we turn data-driven strategies into production systems. Our clients are DAX and Fortune Global 500 leaders who trust us for our expertise across data platforms, big data and cloud engineering. 
You’ll join an international environment with agile squads and a boutique spirit with room to experiment and grow, paired with above‑market compensation and an attractive benefits package.

data.description:
It’s time to change. We change!

Über uns
It’s time to change. We change! Willkommen bei Auvaria, wo Leidenschaft, Teamgeist und Verantwortung unsere Kultur prägen. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter AWS Consulting & Engineering Partner mit Büros in Wien, Hamburg und Belgrad und begleiten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor auf der gesamten Cloud Journey.

Über die Rolle
Was auch immer unsere Kunden im Bereich Data & AI auf AWS vorhaben, wir entwerfen und entwickeln es gemeinsam vom ersten Architecture Workshop bis in Production mit ihnen. Dafür suchen wir dich: als Senior Solutions Architect für Data & AI verantwortest du End-to-End Projekte in deinem Bereich und gestaltest unsere wachsende Data & AI Business Unit aktiv mit.

Architektur & Delivery 

  • Du führst die Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbare AWS-Architekturen für Data Platforms und Gen AI- / Agentic AI-Lösungen
  • Du sorgst für Security, Performance, Reliability und Kosteneffizienz bei unseren Kunden (AWS Well-Architected)
  • Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen samt Trade-offs – und dokumentierst sie so, dass Teams darauf aufbauen können
  • Du übersetzt vage Business-Pain-Points in messbare technische Anforderungen und klare Ziele
  • Du bringst Außenperspektive ein und hebst unsere bestehenden Standards auf das nächste Level.
  • Du beteiligst dich bei technical Pre-Sales, Scoping von Projekten und arbeitest an der Erstellung der Statements of Work
Data & AI 
  • Du entwickelst Generative AI und Agentic AI Solutions auf AWS Bedrock, mit Frameworks wie Strands Agents und Runtime- / Governance-Bausteinen wie Bedrock AgentCore
  • Du entwickelst Agenten-Architekturen mit Tool Use und MCP-basierten Integrationen, Multi-Step-Orchestrierung und klar definierten Grenzen des Agent-Scopes
  • Du baust Human-in-the-Loop-Patterns ein, von Approval-Steps und Eskalationslogik bis zu (teil-)automatisierten Review-Schleifen
  • Du etablierst Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung für LLM- und Agent-Systeme
  • Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie GenAI und Agentic AI pragmatisch und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen
Consulting & Pre-Sales 
  • Du bist Trusted Technical Advisor für unsere Kunden
  • Du unterstützt Pre-Sales und technische Workshops
  • Du übersetzt komplexe Technik in klaren Business Value
  • Knowledge Sharing
  • Du bist Mentor:in für unsere Junior-Kolleg:innen
  • Du bringst dich in interne Standards, Best Practices und Trainings ein und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter


Dein Profil:

Must-haves 

  • 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen
  • Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen
  • Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten
  • Sehr gute Python-Skills
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch; Deutsch auf professionellem Niveau

Nice-to-haves 
  • AWS-Zertifizierungen
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
  • Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
  • Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)
  • Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation
  • Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle)
  • Erfahrung mit Kafka/Streaming


Erstklassige Benefits für deine Karriere!

Vergütung und Vergütungspaket
Bei Auvaria bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass Performance nur unter den richtigen Bedingungen gelingen kann:

  • 4-Tage-Woche (bei 36h reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit) mit vollem Fokus auf Impact.
  • Attraktives Package mit teilweise variablem Gehaltsbestandteil, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung.
  • Schneller, transparenter Hiring-Prozess (in der Regel max. 3 Gespräche, Angebot typischerweise innerhalb von 4 Wochen).
  • Persönliches Mentoring und strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag 1. AWS-Zertifizierungen komplett von uns bezahlt.
  • Remote-freundliches Setup mit wenig Reisetätigkeit (max. 20 % im Jahresschnitt). Regelmäßige Team- und Afterwork-Events an unseren Standorten plus gemeinsame Offsites.
Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

data.description:
MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Sammle Praxiserfahrung in Finance & Digitalisierung – mitten in der Prozessautomatisierung
 
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen endlich in der Praxis anwenden? Du interessierst dich für Daten, digitale Prozesse und Automatisierung, arbeitest strukturiert und möchtest Teil eines motivierten Teams werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team im Bereich Commissions im operativen Tagesgeschäft und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Dabei arbeitest du mit Daten, unterstützt bei bestehenden Prozessen und lernst moderne Technologien und Schnittstellen kennen.
 
Das erwartet dich
 
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team bei der Durchführung, Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Prozesse im Finanzbereich. Dabei übernimmst du klar definierte Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest an kleineren Daten- und Automatisierungsthemen mit.
 
Unter anderem unterstützt du bei:
 

  • Pflege und Überwachung bestehender ETL-Prozesse sowie automatisierter Abläufe
  • Durchführung von Datenvalidierungen, Tests und Qualitätsprüfungen
  • Unterstützung bei Monatsabschlussprozessen und Ad-hoc-Anfragen
  • Mitarbeit an Automatisierungen mit Python, SQL und REST-APIs
  • Aufbereitung von Reports und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen
 
Das bringst du mit
 
  • Laufendes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie Interesse an Python und Prozessautomatisierung
  • Verständnis für Datenstrukturen und Schnittstellen zwischen Systemen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Teamgeist und Freude daran, Neues zu lernen
 
Berufserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und dein Interesse an Daten und digitalen Prozessen.
 
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche, passend zu deinem Studium
  • Freie Verteilung deiner Arbeitszeit – zum Beispiel zwei volle Tage und ein halber Tag oder ganz nach Absprache
  • Praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, SQL und modernen Datenprozessen
  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten
  • Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie persönliche Betreuung
 
 Deine Entwicklung
 
  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in die Digitalisierung von Finanzprozessen
  • Aufbau von Kenntnissen in SQL, Python und ETL-Prozessen
  • Mitarbeit an Daten- und Automatisierungsprojekten
  • Persönliche Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • Wertvolle Berufserfahrung für deinen Karriereweg
 
Arbeiten bei ecotel
 
  • Duz-Kultur auf allen Ebenen
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Karneval
  • Modern ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze
  • Firmenlaptop und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fitnessraum am Standort Düsseldorf
  • Kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst
  • Kostenfreie Parkplätze in unserer Tiefgarage
  • Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung
  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie bezahlter Sonderurlaub bei besonderen persönlichen Ereignissen
  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
 
Attraktive Vergütung

 
  • 1.350 € brutto pro Monat bei einer 20-Stunden-Woche 
 
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
 
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 
Bitte sende uns folgende Unterlagen:
 
  • deinen Lebenslauf
  • deine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
